manaNeeded: {2} plus enough mana to activate the Licid's ability
easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to activate the Licid's ability.
description:
Activate Sparring Mummy using the Licid's ability by paying its activation cost, attaching Sparring Mummy to Yenna and causing Sparring Mummy to become an Aura.
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Sparring Mummy.
When the Sparring Mummy token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Sparring Mummy token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.
